title: Promo codes
lead: Codes buyers type at checkout for a discount on tickets, for every event or one. They belong to your organization, and only its owner can see or change them. A code can be stopped, never deleted: orders keep the discount they were given.
pilot: While payments are off for the free pilot, checkout takes a code only when it makes the order free, such as 100% off. Any other code is kept for when payments start: checkout refuses it until then.
eventsUnread: Your events couldn’t be read, so a new code can only apply to every event for now. Reload the page to try again.

create.title: Make a code
create.codeHelp: 3 to 32 letters, numbers and hyphens. Capitals don’t matter: it is kept in capitals.
create.limit: How many times it can be used (optional)
create.limitHelp: Left empty, there is no limit. Once set, a limit can be changed but not removed.
create.minOrder: Smallest order it applies to, in AMD (optional)
create.zoneHelp: In {{timeZone}}. The start can’t be changed later; the end can, but not removed.

limits.title: Change {{code}}
limits.body: Only the limit and the end can change: what it gives, its event, its minimum and its start can’t.
limits.used_one: Used {{count}} time so far: the limit can’t be lower.
limits.used_other: Used {{count}} times so far: the limit can’t be lower.

stop.title: Stop {{code}}?
stop.body: Checkout refuses it from now on. Orders already made keep their discount, and you can use it again later.

errors.codeChars: Use letters, numbers and hyphens only.
errors.percent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
errors.amount: Enter a whole amount in AMD, above zero.
errors.limit: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
errors.pair: Give both the date and the time, or neither.
errors.timeSkipped: The clocks skip that time in this time zone that day. Choose another.
errors.untilBefore: The end must come after the start.
errors.belowUsed: It has been used more times than that already.
errors.cantClear: Once set, this can be changed but not removed.

refused.codeTaken: You already have a code called that.
refused.belowUsed: It has been used more times than that already.
refused.untilRefused: The end must come after the start.
refused.eventGone: That event is no longer yours. The page has been reloaded.
refused.gone: That code is no longer there. The page has been reloaded.
refused.forbidden: Only the organization’s owner can see or change promo codes: discounts are revenue.
refused.noOrganization: Promo codes belong to an organization, and your account is on an event only. The organization’s owner can make them.
refused.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
refused.noAnswer: No answer came. Check the list, then try again.
refused.chooseOrganization: Your account is in more than one organization, and this page can’t choose between them yet.
